children: XRP spot ETFs recorded $110 million in net inflows during the trading days from August 24 to August 28, U.S. Eastern Time. According to ChainCatcher, Bitwise ETF XRP led weekly inflows with $59.95 million, bringing its cumulative net inflows to $603 million.

Franklin Templeton's XRPZ ranked second with $28.7 million in weekly net inflows and $463 million in cumulative net inflows. As of press time, XRP spot ETFs held $1.44 billion in net assets, with an ETF net asset ratio of 1.66% and cumulative net inflows of $1.66 billion.

title: XRP Spot ETFs Record $110 Million Net Inflow Last Week
